supporting_observations.claim: Two failed logons for COPPERLINE\kim.nguyen occurred on WS-KNGUYEN-01 at 13:38:45 and 13:38:47 UTC. Both were LogonType 2 attempts by winlogon, with status 0xc000006d and bad-password substatus 0xc000006a.
The failures are recorded as local interactive logons, not network logons, and the records provide no source IP address or other remote origin.

At 13:39:58 UTC, sara.ali on WS-SALI-01 used mstsc.exe with explicit credentials targeting kim.nguyen on WS-KNGUYEN-01. This occurred after the failures, but the record does not establish that it caused or was otherwise connected to them.

known_telemetry_limitations: Winsec and Sysmon collection for DC-COP-01 and FILE-COP-01 was unavailable from 13:30 to 14:15 UTC, limiting corroboration of authentication activity at those hosts.
The two failure records identify the local workstation and winlogon process but do not include a source IP or identify who initiated the attempts.
claims_not_established: Whether the two bad-password attempts resulted from a user mistake or deliberate activity.
Whether the explicit-credential event from sara.ali was an authorized support action or related to the failed attempts.
Whether additional failed or successful authentication events occurred on DC-COP-01 or FILE-COP-01 during the collection outage.
additional_evidence_needed: Recover or obtain domain-controller authentication records for 13:20–14:20 UTC, especially failures and successes for kim.nguyen.
Review WS-KNGUYEN-01 authentication records and interactive session activity around 13:38–14:00 UTC for a successful logon or additional failures.
Determine the purpose and outcome of the 13:39:58 mstsc explicit-credential event on WS-SALI-01, including any corresponding RDP logon records on WS-KNGUYEN-01.
